points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 汤显祖出生于江西抚州一个书香门第，自幼聪颖好学。在抚州期间，他接受了系统的传统教育，研习经史子集，尤其擅长诗词歌赋。这一时期奠定了他的文学基础，培养了对戏曲的浓厚兴趣。21岁时，他参加乡试中举，展现出卓越的文学才华。抚州的生活经历和早期教育对他后来的文学创作产生了深远影响，特别是他对社会现实的关注和对人性的深刻理解。
points.descriptionEn: Tang Xianzu was born into a scholarly family in Fuzhou, Jiangxi, where he received a comprehensive traditional education, studying classics, history, and literature. He showed exceptional literary talent from a young age and developed a strong interest in opera. At 21, he passed the provincial examination (juren), demonstrating his literary prowess. His early life in Fuzhou and education profoundly influenced his later literary works, particularly his focus on social reality and deep understanding of human nature.

points.title: 科举之路
points.description: 汤显祖前往南京参加会试，但多次落第。在南京期间，他与当时许多文人雅士交往，广泛阅读各类书籍，思想更加开阔。他开始对科举制度产生质疑，认为其束缚人才。这一时期，他创作了大量诗文，逐渐形成自己独特的文学风格。南京的多元文化氛围和与各阶层人士的交往，使他的视野更加开阔，为他后来的戏剧创作积累了丰富素材。同时，他对社会不公现象的批判意识也日益增强。
points.descriptionEn: Tang went to Nanjing to participate in the metropolitan examination but failed multiple times. During his time in Nanjing, he interacted with many scholars and intellectuals, read extensively, and broadened his horizons. He began to question the imperial examination system, believing it stifled talent. This period saw him producing numerous poems and essays, gradually developing his unique literary style. The diverse cultural atmosphere and interactions with people from all walks of life in Nanjing expanded his perspective and provided rich material for his later dramatic works.

points.title: 为官生涯
points.description: 汤显祖于1583年考中进士，被任命为浙江遂昌知县。在遂昌任职期间，他推行仁政，减轻赋税，兴修水利，发展教育，深受百姓爱戴。他敢于与权贵抗争，保护弱势群体，展现了正直不阿的品格。然而，他的改革措施触动了既得利益者，遭到排挤和打压。1598年，他愤而辞官，结束了短暂的仕途生涯。在遂昌的经历使他对社会现实有了更深刻的认识，也为他后来的戏剧创作提供了丰富的素材和思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1583, Tang passed the highest imperial examination and was appointed as the magistrate of Suichang, Zhejiang. During his tenure, he implemented benevolent governance, reduced taxes, constructed water conservancy projects, and promoted education, earning deep respect from the local people. He dared to stand up against powerful officials and protect the vulnerable, demonstrating his integrity. However, his reform measures provoked the vested interests, leading to political persecution. In 1598, he resigned in frustration, ending his brief official career. His experiences in Suichang gave him a deeper understanding of social reality and provided rich material and ideological foundation for his later dramatic works.

points.title: 戏剧创作
points.description: 辞官回到家乡临川后，汤显祖专注于戏剧创作，进入了艺术生涯的黄金时期。这一时期，他创作了被誉为'临川四梦'的四大传奇剧作：《牡丹亭》、《紫钗记》、《邯郸记》和《南柯记》。其中，《牡丹亭》最为著名，通过杜丽娘与柳梦梅的爱情故事，表达了'情至'的核心理念，反对封建礼教对人性的束缚。他的戏剧作品语言优美，情节曲折，人物形象鲜明，具有强烈的艺术感染力和思想深度。这一时期的创作奠定了他在中国戏曲史上的重要地位，对后世戏曲发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to his hometown Linchuan, Tang devoted himself to dramatic creation, entering the golden period of his artistic career. During this time, he created his four major plays known as 'The Four Dreams of Linchuan': 'The Peony Pavilion', 'The Purple Hairpin', 'Handan Dream', and 'The South Branch Dream'. Among them, 'The Peony Pavilion' is the most famous, expressing the core concept of 'love as ultimate' through the love story of Du Liniang and Liu Mengmei, opposing the feudal ethical code's constraints on human nature. His works feature beautiful language, intricate plots, vivid characters, and strong artistic appeal and ideological depth. This period established his important position in Chinese theater history and had a profound influence on later theatrical development.

points.title: 逝世与影响
points.description: 1616年，汤显祖在江西临川逝世，享年67岁。他的逝世标志着中国戏曲史上一个重要时代的结束。然而，他的文学成就和思想影响却远远超越了他的生命。他的'临川四梦'成为中国古典戏曲的经典之作，尤其是《牡丹亭》至今仍在舞台上广为演出，影响深远。汤显祖的'情至'思想对后世文学创作产生了重要影响，成为中国文学史上浪漫主义传统的重要代表。他的作品被翻译成多种语言，在世界范围内传播，成为中国文化的重要名片。如今，汤显祖被公认为中国最伟大的剧作家之一，其文学成就和思想价值得到了广泛认可。
points.descriptionEn: In 1616, Tang Xianzu passed away in Linchuan, Jiangxi, at the age of 67. His death marked the end of an important era in Chinese theater history. However, his literary achievements and ideological influence far exceeded his lifetime. His 'Four Dreams of Linchuan' became classics of Chinese traditional opera, especially 'The Peony Pavilion,' which continues to be widely performed today with profound influence. Tang's concept of 'love as ultimate' had a significant impact on later literary creation, becoming an important representative of the romantic tradition in Chinese literary history. His works have been translated into multiple languages and spread worldwide, becoming an important cultural ambassador for China. Today, Tang is widely recognized as one of China's greatest playwrights, with his literary achievements and ideological values receiving broad recognition.

supporter.zh: 汤显祖是中国戏曲史上的一座丰碑，他的'临川四梦'尤其是《牡丹亭》，将中国古典戏剧艺术推向了新的高度。他通过戏剧作品表达了对人性解放的追求，对封建礼教的批判，以及对真情的歌颂。汤显祖的'情至'思想超越了时代的局限，具有永恒的人文价值。他不仅是一位杰出的剧作家，更是一位思想家，他的作品影响了中国文学的发展轨迹，为中国戏曲注入了新的生命力。
supporter.en: Tang Xianzu stands as a monumental figure in Chinese theater history. His 'Four Dreams of Linchuan,' particularly 'The Peony Pavilion,' elevated Chinese classical dramatic art to new heights. Through his works, he expressed the pursuit of human liberation, critique of feudal ethical codes, and celebration of true emotions. Tang's concept of 'love as ultimate' transcended the limitations of his time, possessing eternal humanistic value. He was not only an outstanding playwright but also a thinker whose works influenced the trajectory of Chinese literature and injected new vitality into Chinese opera.

critic.zh: 批评者认为汤显祖的作品过于强调个人情感，忽视了社会责任和集体利益。他的戏剧中的人物形象有时过于理想化，脱离现实社会。此外，汤显祖虽然批判封建礼教，但并未提出系统的社会改革方案，只是停留在艺术表达层面。他的'情至'思想也被认为过于浪漫化，缺乏对现实社会复杂性的深刻理解。在政治生涯中，汤显祖的仕途短暂且未能实现更大的政治抱负，这也反映了他理想主义性格的局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Tang's works overemphasize individual emotions while neglecting social responsibility and collective interests. The characters in his plays are sometimes overly idealized, detached from real society. Although Tang criticized feudal ethical codes, he failed to propose systematic social reform programs, remaining confined to artistic expression. His concept of 'love as ultimate' is also considered overly romanticized, lacking a deep understanding of the complexities of real society. In his political career, Tang's official tenure was brief and未能实现 greater political ambitions, reflecting the limitations of his idealistic character.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，汤显祖被公认为中国最伟大的剧作家之一，其作品已成为中国古典戏剧的经典代表。在学术界，他的戏剧创作被视为中国戏曲从传统向现代转型的重要标志。汤显祖的'情至'思想被重新解读为对个体价值的肯定，对人性解放的追求，这与现代人文主义精神相契合。在当代文化中，汤显祖的形象超越了单纯的文学范畴，成为中国文化的重要符号，代表着对自由、爱情和人性的永恒追求。他的作品被改编成各种艺术形式，在当代舞台上焕发新的生命力。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Tang Xianzu is widely recognized as one of China's greatest playwrights, whose works have become classic representatives of Chinese traditional theater. In academic circles, his dramatic creation is seen as an important marker in the transition of Chinese opera from tradition to modernity. Tang's concept of 'love as ultimate' has been reinterpreted as affirmation of individual value and pursuit of human liberation, aligning with modern humanistic spirit. In contemporary culture, Tang's image transcends the purely literary realm, becoming an important symbol of Chinese culture that represents the eternal pursuit of freedom, love, and humanity. His works have been adapted into various art forms, continuing to thrive on contemporary stages.

self.zh: 情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死可以生。
self.en: Love knows no reason, it grows ever deeper; the living may die for it, and the dead may live because of it.

others.zh: 汤显祖是中国文学史上的一颗明珠，他的戏剧作品不仅艺术成就极高，而且思想深刻，影响深远。
others.en: Tang Xianzu is a pearl in the history of Chinese literature. His dramatic works not only possess extremely high artistic achievements but also profound thought and far-reaching influence.
